name: To Do List Application
description: A modern, feature-rich To-Do List application built with Vanilla TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, focusing on clean architecture and accessibility.

tasks.description: Manually Scaffold Vite + TypeScript Project
details: Create package.json manually with type: module
Setup tsconfig.json for Vite environment
Create index.html and src/main.ts
Run npm install silently

tasks.description: Install & Configure Tailwind CSS
details: Install tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer
Initialize tailwind.config.js and postcss.config.js
Configure content paths in tailwind.config.js
Create src/styles/main.css with Tailwind directives

tasks.description: Pre-bake the Testing Environment (Vitest + JSDOM)
details: Install vitest and jsdom
Configure vitest.config.ts for JSDOM environment
Add test script to package.json
Create tests/env.test.ts to verify environment

tasks.description: Define Core TypeScript Types and Interfaces
details: Define Priority and TodoStatus union types
Define Todo, FilterState, and AppState interfaces in types/index.ts

tasks.description: Implement the ID Generation Utility
details: Create src/utils/id.ts with generateId() using crypto.randomUUID()
Export from src/utils/index.ts

tasks.description: Implement Date Utility Functions
details: Implement getNow, formatDate, and isOverdue in src/utils/date.ts
Ensure formatDate uses Intl.DateTimeFormat

tasks.description: Implement LocalStorage Persistence Utilities
details: Implement saveState and loadState in src/store/persistence.ts
Handle serialization and errors

tasks.description: Define the Default Application State
details: Implement getDefaultState in src/store/defaultState.ts
Ensure it returns a new object every call

tasks.description: Implement the State Store with Subscriber Pattern
details: Implement getState, subscribe, and setState in src/store/store.ts
Handle subscriber notifications

tasks.description: Implement All Todo Mutation Actions
details: Implement addTodo, removeTodo, toggleTodo, updateTodo, setFilter, and setEditingId in src/store/actions.ts

tasks.description: Implement the Derived Selector for Filtered Todos
details: Implement getFilteredTodos in src/store/selectors.ts
Apply filters and sorting logic

tasks.description: Bootstrap the Root HTML Shell
details: Setup #app div in index.html
Initialize app mounting in src/main.ts

tasks.description: Implement the createElement DOM Utility
details: Create src/utils/dom.ts with typed createElement helper

tasks.description: Implement the Header Component
details: Create src/components/Header.ts with Tailwind styling

tasks.description: Implement the Stats Bar Component
details: Create src/components/StatsBar.ts to display todo counts

tasks.description: Implement the Filter Bar Component
details: Create src/components/FilterBar.ts with search and select inputs

tasks.description: Implement the Add-Todo Form Component
details: Create src/components/AddTodoForm.ts with validation logic

tasks.description: Implement the Todo Card Component
details: Create src/components/TodoCard.ts with interactive elements

tasks.description: Implement the Edit-Todo Modal Component
details: Create src/components/EditTodoModal.ts with overlay and form

tasks.description: Implement the Empty State Component
details: Create src/components/EmptyState.ts for empty lists/filters

tasks.description: Implement the Todo List Renderer
details: Create src/components/TodoList.ts to manage list of cards and modal

tasks.description: Implement the Main App Render Function
details: Create src/app.ts to orchestrate full page rendering

tasks.description: Bootstrap and Subscribe the Renderer in main.ts
details: Wire up store subscription to app render

tasks.description: Add ARIA Attributes to All Interactive Components
details: Ensure high accessibility standards across all components

tasks.description: Implement Keyboard Trap for the Edit Modal
details: Handle Escape and Tab navigation within modal

tasks.description: Configure Vite Production Build Options
details: Setup vite.config.ts for production dist

tasks.description: Validate Full LocalStorage Round-Trip on Page Reload
details: Verify persistence and schema migrations

tasks.description: Test Case: Manually Scaffold Vite + TypeScript Project
details: Strictly run npm exec tsc --noEmit and assert zero errors. Verify that index.html and src/main.ts exist.

tasks.description: Test Case: Install & Configure Tailwind CSS
details: Add a temporary div with class='bg-red-500' in index.html. Start the dev server and assert via curl or visually that the Tailwind classes are compiled and applied.

tasks.description: Test Case: Pre-bake the Testing Environment (Vitest + JSDOM)
details: Create a dummy test file tests/env.test.ts. Write a test asserting that typeof window !== 'undefined' and typeof document !== 'undefined'. Run npm run test and assert it passes without any manual DOM mocking.

tasks.description: Test Case: Define Core TypeScript Types and Interfaces
details: Assert that Priority and TodoStatus union types are exported and correctly defined. Verify that a mock object matching the Todo interface structure contains all required keys and correctly typed values. Ensure npm exec tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors in the test file.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the ID Generation Utility
details: Call generateId() 1000 times in a test loop and assert that all returned values are unique strings matching the UUID v4 regex.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement Date Utility Functions
details: Assert that formatDate(new Date('2024-01-15').getTime()) returns 'Jan 15, 2024'. Assert isOverdue(null) returns false. Assert isOverdue(Date.now() - 1000) returns true. Assert isOverdue(Date.now() + 100000) returns false.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement LocalStorage Persistence Utilities
details: Call saveState with a valid AppState, then call loadState and assert the returned object deeply equals the saved object. Call loadState on a fresh localStorage and assert null is returned. Simulate a corrupt JSON string in localStorage and assert loadState returns null without throwing.

tasks.description: Test Case: Define the Default Application State
details: Call getDefaultState() twice and assert the two returned objects are deeply equal but not the same reference (!==).

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the State Store with Subscriber Pattern
details: Call setState with an updater that appends a todo, then call getState and assert the todo is present. Subscribe a callback, call setState, and assert the callback was invoked exactly once. Call the returned unsubscribe function, call setState again, and assert the callback was NOT invoked a second time.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement All Todo Mutation Actions
details: For each action, call it with valid arguments and assert getState() reflects the expected change. Test removeTodo with a non-existent ID and assert state is unchanged. Test toggleTodo twice on the same todo and assert it returns to 'pending' with completedAt: null.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the Derived Selector for Filtered Todos
details: Seed a state with 5 todos of mixed status and priority. Assert the correct count is returned for each filter combination. Assert the sort order: most recently created pending todos appear first. Assert completed todos are always last regardless of their createdAt.

tasks.description: Test Case: Bootstrap the Root HTML Shell
details: In a JSDOM environment, assert that document.getElementById('app') is not null after index.html is parsed. Assert that removing #app from the DOM and re-running the bootstrap throws the expected error.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the createElement DOM Utility
details: Call createElement('button', ['btn', 'btn-primary'], { 'data-id': '123', 'aria-label': 'Close' }) and assert the returned element is an HTMLButtonElement, has className 'btn btn-primary', and has the correct attribute values.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the Header Component
details: Call Header() and assert the returned element is an HTMLElement with tagName === 'HEADER'. Assert it contains exactly one <h1> with textContent === 'My Todos'. Assert calling it twice returns different object references.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the Stats Bar Component
details: Pass an array of 3 pending and 2 completed todos. Assert the total text content includes '5', the pending includes '3', and the completed includes '2'. Pass an empty array and assert all three display '0'.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the Filter Bar Component
details: Render with filter = { status: 'completed', priority: 'high', searchQuery: 'test' } and assert each control's .value matches. Simulate an input event on the search field and assert onChange is called with { searchQuery: <new value> }.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the Add-Todo Form Component
details:
Simulate a submit with an empty title and assert onSubmit was NOT called and an error

appears in the DOM. Simulate a valid submit with all fields filled and assert onSubmit was called with the correct typed arguments and the inputs are cleared afterward.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the Todo Card Component
details: Render a completed todo and assert the checkbox is checked and the title element has the strike-through class. Render a high-priority todo and assert the badge element has a red-related Tailwind class. Simulate clicking delete and assert onDelete was called with the correct ID.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the Edit-Todo Modal Component
details: Render with a todo, change the title input value, simulate Save, and assert onSave was called with the new title. Assert onSave is NOT called when title is cleared. Simulate clicking the close button and assert onClose was called.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the Empty State Component
details: Render with isFiltered = false and assert the text content contains 'No todos yet'. Render with isFiltered = true and assert the text content contains 'No todos match'.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the Todo List Renderer
details: Pass 3 todos and assert the returned <ul> has exactly 3 <li> children. Pass an editingId matching the second todo and assert the DOM contains an element with an <h2> of text Edit Todo. Pass an empty array and assert no <ul> is returned.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement the Main App Render Function
details: Mount render onto a JSDOM <div>, assert the root contains a <header>, an element with placeholder='Search todos...', and an empty-state element. Call addTodo(...) then render(root) and assert the todo card appears. Call setFilter({ status: 'completed' }), render(root), and assert the empty-state shows the filtered variant.

tasks.description: Test Case: Bootstrap and Subscribe the Renderer in main.ts
details: In a JSDOM environment, run the bootstrap sequence and assert that the DOM contains a <header>. Then dispatch addTodo(...) via the store and assert (without calling render manually) that the new todo card appears in the DOM.

tasks.description: Test Case: Add ARIA Attributes to All Interactive Components
details: Render each component and assert the expected aria-* attributes are present using getAttribute. Render the modal and assert role='dialog' is set on the container. Render a completed todo's checkbox and assert aria-label contains 'incomplete'.

tasks.description: Test Case: Implement Keyboard Trap for the Edit Modal
details: Render the modal, simulate an Escape keydown event, and assert onClose was called. Simulate Tab on the last focusable element and assert focus moves to the first. Simulate Shift+Tab on the first and assert focus moves to the last.

tasks.description: Test Case: Configure Vite Production Build Options
details: Open dist/index.html in a browser (or serve it) and perform a manual smoke test.

tasks.description: Test Case: Validate Full LocalStorage Round-Trip on Page Reload
details: Manually corrupt localStorage['todo-app-state'] to {'todos': []} (missing filter key) and reload. Assert the app renders without errors, showing the empty state rather than a runtime exception.
